comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
New equipment.

Wise Adventurer's Outfit (male only)
Archaeology +3
Appraisal +1
Procurement +1
EX Effect: Reduce Vigour Consumption

Basically a red/white version of the John Tradescant outfit. It's currently being offered as one of three prizes to the first three players to reach Level 85 in any job.

Source: uwo.ogplanet.com/en/news/update/9738.og

It may be available in a future bottle drop.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
New +2 Archaeology weapon:

Gastraphetes Crossbow
100 Durability
45 Attack
+2 Bow Attack
+2 Archaeology
10,000 fame to equip

It's awarded for completing a merchant quest from London to Athens (*5-star difficulty, name: Deliver the Light Crossbow) which involves giving x1 Light Crossbow from Manchester to a Craftsman NPC in Athens. Not sure if it's a one-time reward, or can be acquired repeatably at thia time.
